text: Natural Language Processing, or NLP, is a field of artificial intelligence that helps computers understand human language. Instead of just reading words as plain text, NLP allows machines to grasp the meaning behind sentences. This technology powers many everyday tools, such as automatic translation services that convert languages instantly. Another common use is sentiment analysis, which determines whether a piece of writing, like a product review, is positive, negative, or neutral. Additionally, NLP is the brain behind chatbots, which can hold conversations and answer customer questions. By combining grammar rules with machine learning, NLP makes human-computer interaction more natural and useful.
